description: Connect ChatGPT to your Atelier workspace to manage interior design projects, tasks, products, clients, vendors, FF&E schedules, timelines, timers, and pinboards. Find products, review prices and lead times, create and assign tasks, and build project schedules. Create private project pinboards and add existing library products directly to them. Import product details from a product URL or an attached PDF, save selected products to your library, and place them on a pinboard. Product images can be uploaded separately; embedded PDF photos are not extracted automatically. Create shareable pinboard links when you want to share a board. Atelier uses OAuth to scope requests to your connected Studio.

defaultPrompt: Show me my active Atelier projects and tell me which one was updated most recently.
Find my living-room products and summarize their prices, lead times, and vendors.
Turn these meeting notes into separate Atelier tasks, assign them to me, and put them on today’s plan.
